title: PCEP: Stub in support for more objects
description:
Stub in support for PCEP objects that aren't yet in the dissector,
as per https://www.iana.org/assignments/pcep/pcep.xhtml :
* 22: CLASSTYPE
* 24: GLOBAL-CONSTRAINTS
* 36: INTER-LAYER
* 37: SWITCH-LAYER
* 38: REQ-ADAP-CAP
* 39: SERVER-INDICATION
* 41: S2LS
* 42: WA
* 43: FLOWSPEC
* 44: CCI Object-Type
* 45: PATH-ATTRIB

**Does not** dissect these objects yet. *Does* give them their names in
the protocol tree. Still shows expert info
`pcep.object_body_non_defined` for them.

Code smell change: Wherever objects are specified, re-arrange them if
necessary to always list them in increasing order by number. This makes
it easier to tell if one has been overlooked.
